name: DeerFlow Super-Agent Harness
mechanism: Provides a full agent harness with planning, subagents, memory, skills, workspaces, channels, gateway APIs and selectable local or isolated sandbox providers.
use_when: The product needs an integrated research or coding super-agent surface
Gateway, channels, skills and workspace execution would otherwise be assembled separately
avoid_when: The application needs an embeddable minimal runtime library
The deployment would enable host shell access without isolation and tenant controls
expected_effects: Rapid delivery of an integrated long-horizon agent experience
Shared planning, subagent, memory and workspace conventions
failure_modes: Local sandbox is mistaken for a security boundary
Large integrated surface increases patch and configuration burden
Major-version rewrites create migration and compatibility risk
required_evals: end-to-end workload cost latency and recovery
